name: 葉京澔
objective:
本課程主要在讓學生了解鐵道號誌系統的基本原理，同時藉由此課程了解現代通訊技術的概念，以此建立對於鐵道列車的控制基本觀念。
This course mainly allows students to understand the basic principles of the railway signaling system, and at the same time understand the concepts of modern communication technology through this course, so as to establish the basic concepts of railway train control.
